name: T2I-CompBench++
description: T2I-CompBench++ is an enhanced benchmark for compositional text-to-image generation, containing 8,000 compositional text prompts categorized into groups such as attribute binding, object relationships, generative numeracy, and complex compositions. It introduces new evaluation metrics including detection-based metrics for 3D-spatial relationships and numeracy, and leverages multimodal large language models for evaluation.
typical_sota_score: varies by subtask; reported top-model performance typically ranges roughly 40–70% on automated compositional/attribute accuracy measures depending on category
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark that extends compositional text-to-image evaluation and is mainly used in research on compositional generation.
notes: Includes new sub-categories like 3D-spatial relationships and numeracy; evaluates 11 text-to-image models including state-of-the-art.
